//: Game events at which the runtime starts a Bedrock effect itself, in place of the Java particles the event spawns: Bedrock starts its effect once where Java spawns a burst, or Bedrock gives one Java particle type's uses to different effects. effect: the effect Bedrock starts there; replaces: the Java particle types Bedrock starts their (Geyser-mapped) effect for only at sites, so they never map particle by particle.

block_destruct.reason: Bedrock starts block_destruct once for a broken block (48 particles), a crack while mining, a sprint step, a fall and a brushed flake; Java's other block particles, the warden's digging and the breeze's jumps, are other effects in Bedrock

critical_hit.reason: Java's critical hit is a tracking emitter of many crit particles; Bedrock starts critical_hit_emitter once per hit

totem.reason: Java's totem is a tracking emitter of many particles; Bedrock starts totem_particle once per use

potion_splash.reason: Java spawns 100 spell particles per splash potion (instant_effect for instant potions); Bedrock starts splash_spell_emitter once per splash. Java's other effect particles are the spectral arrow's trail (the arrow_trail site) and a brown mooshroom's, which stay Java's

mace_smash.reason: Java spawns dust pillar particles by the hundred per mace smash; Bedrock starts smash_ground_particle once per smash

mace_smash_center.reason: Bedrock starts smash_ground_particle_center beside smash_ground_particle at each smash

status_effect.reason: Bedrock starts mobspell_emitter for each swirl of an entity's status effects; Java spawns one entity_effect particle for it

status_effect_ambient.reason: Bedrock starts mobspell_ambient for each swirl of ambient effects (a beacon's, a conduit's); Java spawns one faint entity_effect particle for it

arrow_trail.reason: Bedrock starts arrow_spell_emitter for the trail of a tipped and of a spectral arrow; Java spawns one entity_effect (tipped) or effect (spectral) particle for each

lingering_cloud.reason: Bedrock starts mobspell_lingering for a lingering potion's cloud; Java spawns its entity_effect particles over the cloud each tick
